## 🏗️ Complete Workflow Architecture

The workflow orchestrates translation through 3 major phases:

### High-Level Flow

```
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  Command: /translate-content [source.md] [markets] [pub]   │
└────────┬────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
         │
         ├─────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
         │                                                 │
    [Phase 1]                                          [Phase 2]
    Analysis (10 min)                           Batch Translation (20 min)
         │                                                 │
         ▼                                                 ▼
    ┌─────────────────┐                          ┌──────────────────┐
    │ Content-Parser  │                          │ EMEA Batch       │
    │ Context Extract │                          │ (5 agents)       │
    └─────────────────┘                          └──────────────────┘
         │                                                 │
         │ [HOOK: source-validation]              ┌───────┼───────┐
         │                                        │       │       │
         ▼                                        ▼       ▼       ▼
    ┌─────────────────┐                    ┌──┐ ┌──┐ ┌──┐ ┌──┐ ┌──┐
    │ Analysis Brief  │                    │FR│ │DE│ │ES│ │IT│ │NL│
    └─────────────────┘                    └──┘ └──┘ └──┘ └──┘ └──┘
         │
         │                                     ┌──────────────────┐
         │                                     │ APAC Batch       │
         │                                     │ (5 agents)       │
         │                                     └──────────────────┘
         │                                             │
         │                                     ┌───────┼───────┐
         │                                     │       │       │
         │                                     ▼       ▼       ▼
         │                                ┌──┐ ┌──┐ ┌──┐ ┌──┐ ┌──┐
         │                                │JA│ │KO│ │ZH│ │TW│ │HI│
         │                                └──┘ └──┘ └──┘ └──┘ └──┘
         │
         │                                     ┌──────────────────┐
         │                                     │ AMERICAS Batch   │
         │                                     │ (3 agents)       │
         │                                     └──────────────────┘
         │                                             │
         │                                     ┌───────┼───────┐
         │                                     │       │       │
         │                                     ▼       ▼       ▼
         │                                    ┌──┐   ┌──┐   ┌──┐
         │                                    │PT│   │ES│   │FR│
         │                                    │BR│   │MX│   │CA│
         │                                    └──┘   └──┘   └──┘
         │
         │ [HOOK: cultural-check]
         │
         ▼
    [Phase 3]
    Validation (15 min)
         │
    ┌────┴────────────────────┐
    │                         │
    ▼                         ▼
┌─────────────┐         ┌──────────────┐
│ QA Validator│         │ CMS Publisher│
│ (Automated) │         │  (Regional)  │
└─────────────┘         └──────────────┘
    │                         │
    └────────┬────────────────┘
             │
    [HOOK: quality-gate]
             │
             ▼
       ┌──────────────┐
       │  Published   │
       │  13 URLs     │
       │ Quality 85+  │
       └──────────────┘
```

## 📦 Phase 1: Source Analysis

Analyze and prepare content for translation in parallel:

```
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│         /translate-analyze [source.md]              │
└──────────────────────┬───────────────────────────────┘
                       │
         ┌─────────────┴──────────────┐
         │                            │
         ▼                            ▼
   ┌──────────────────┐         ┌────────────────┐
   │  Agent 1         │         │  Agent 2       │
   │ Content-Parser   │         │ Context-Extract│
   │                  │         │                │
   │ Extracts:        │         │ Identifies:    │
   │ • Structure      │         │ • Idioms       │
   │ • Metadata       │         │ • Cultural refs│
   │ • Code blocks    │         │ • Date formats │
   │ • Special items  │         │ • Measurement │
   │ • Formatting     │         │ • Sensitivity │
   └────────┬─────────┘         └────────┬───────┘
            │                            │
            │         (PARALLEL)         │
            │                            │
            └────────────┬───────────────┘
                         │
                         ▼
              ┌──────────────────────┐
              │  Translation Brief   │
              │  ├─ 1,500 words      │
              │  ├─ Complexity: HIGH │
              │  ├─ Special terms: 8 │
              │  └─ Est. time: 20min │
              └──────────────────────┘
```

**Output format**:
```json
{
  "source_analysis": {
    "structure": {
      "title": "...",
      "sections": [...]
    },
    "cultural_context": {
      "challenges": [...],
      "localization_rules": {...}
    },
    "translation_brief": {
      "total_words": 1500,
      "complexity": "medium",
      "estimated_time_per_language": "15 minutes"
    }
  }
}
```

## 🌐 Phase 2: Batch Translation

Three regional batches execute **in parallel**:

### EMEA Batch (Europe, Middle East, Africa)

```
EMEA Translation Batch (5 agents in parallel)
────────────────────────────────────────────

Batch Start: t=0min
   │
   ├─ [AG-FR] French Translator → output.json
   │  └─ Quality: 92/100 | Time: 14 min
   │
   ├─ [AG-DE] German Translator → output.json
   │  └─ Quality: 89/100 | Time: 15 min
   │
   ├─ [AG-ES] Spanish Translator → output.json
   │  └─ Quality: 91/100 | Time: 13 min
   │
   ├─ [AG-IT] Italian Translator → output.json
   │  └─ Quality: 88/100 | Time: 14 min
   │
   └─ [AG-NL] Dutch Translator → output.json
      └─ Quality: 90/100 | Time: 13 min

Batch End: t=15min (max of all agents)

EMEA Summary:
├─ Languages: 5
├─ Total words translated: 7,500
├─ Avg quality: 90/100
├─ Parallel execution: 15 min (not 70 min sequential)
└─ API cost: $45
```

### APAC Batch (Asia Pacific)

```
APAC Translation Batch (5 agents in parallel)
────────────────────────────────────────────

Batch Start: t=0min (parallel to EMEA)
   │
   ├─ [AG-JA] Japanese Translator → output.json
   │  └─ Quality: 87/100 | Time: 18 min
   │
   ├─ [AG-KO] Korean Translator → output.json
   │  └─ Quality: 91/100 | Time: 16 min
   │
   ├─ [AG-ZH-CN] Chinese Simplified → output.json
   │  └─ Quality: 89/100 | Time: 17 min
   │
   ├─ [AG-ZH-TW] Chinese Traditional → output.json
   │  └─ Quality: 88/100 | Time: 17 min
   │
   └─ [AG-HI] Hindi Translator → output.json
      └─ Quality: 85/100 | Time: 19 min

Batch End: t=19min (max of all agents)

APAC Summary:
├─ Languages: 5
├─ Total words translated: 7,500
├─ Avg quality: 88/100
├─ Parallel execution: 19 min
└─ API cost: $55
```

### AMERICAS Batch (North & South America)

```
AMERICAS Translation Batch (3 agents in parallel)
──────────────────────────────────────────────

Batch Start: t=0min (parallel to EMEA + APAC)
   │
   ├─ [AG-PT-BR] Portuguese (Brazil) → output.json
   │  └─ Quality: 93/100 | Time: 13 min
   │
   ├─ [AG-ES-MX] Spanish (Latin America) → output.json
   │  └─ Quality: 90/100 | Time: 12 min
   │
   └─ [AG-FR-CA] French (Canada) → output.json
      └─ Quality: 92/100 | Time: 13 min

Batch End: t=13min

AMERICAS Summary:
├─ Languages: 3
├─ Total words translated: 4,500
├─ Avg quality: 92/100
├─ Parallel execution: 13 min
└─ API cost: $30
```

```
Timeline Comparison:

Sequential (WRONG):
├─ FR: 14 min
├─ DE: 15 min
├─ ES: 13 min
├─ IT: 14 min
├─ NL: 13 min
├─ JA: 18 min
├─ KO: 16 min
├─ ZH-CN: 17 min
├─ ZH-TW: 17 min
├─ HI: 19 min
├─ PT-BR: 13 min
├─ ES-MX: 12 min
└─ FR-CA: 13 min
   ────────────
   TOTAL: 194 minutes ❌

Parallel (CORRECT):
├─ EMEA (5 agents) ───────────────────► 15 min
├─ APAC (5 agents) ───────────────────► 19 min (parallel)
├─ AMERICAS (3 agents) ───────────────► 13 min (parallel)
   ─────────────────────────────────────
   TOTAL: 19 minutes (max of batches) ✅

Speedup: 194 ÷ 19 = 10.2x faster
```

## ✅ Phase 3: Quality Assurance & Publishing

Sequential validation ensures quality before publishing:

```
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│   /translate-validate [translations]         │
└─────────────────┬────────────────────────────┘
                  │
                  ▼
          ┌───────────────────┐
          │  Agent 1: QA      │
          │  Validator        │
          │                   │
          │ Checks per lang:  │
          │ • Completeness    │
          │ • Formatting      │
          │ • Localization    │
          │ • SEO metadata    │
          │ • Language quality│
          │                   │
          │ Score: 0-100      │
          │ Threshold: 85+    │
          └────────┬──────────┘
                   │
                   ▼
          ┌────────────────────┐
          │ All pass (≥85)?    │
          └────┬───────────┬───┘
              NO           YES
               │            │
               ▼            ▼
          Regenerate    ┌──────────────┐
          (retry)       │  Agent 2:    │
               │        │ CMS Publisher│
               │        │              │
               │        │ For each lang│
               │        │ • Select CMS │
               │        │ • Upload imgs│
               │        │ • Create post│
               │        │ • Set hreflng│
               │        │ • Publish    │
               │        │              │
               └───────►└──────────────┘
                        │
                        ▼
                ┌──────────────────┐
                │ Output: 13 URLs  │
                │ + Analytics      │
                │ + Report         │
                └──────────────────┘
```

## 🔀 Content Flow with Hooks

Integration points for validation and quality gates:

```
Source Content
       │
       ├─ [HOOK: source-validation]
       │  └─ Check: no placeholders, links absolute, images accessible
       │     └─ FAIL → Fix source, retry
       │     └─ PASS → Continue
       │
       ▼
   Analysis Phase
       │
       ├─ [HOOK: cultural-check]
       │  └─ Check: localization applied per language
       │     └─ FAIL → Alert human, regenerate
       │     └─ PASS → Continue
       │
       ▼
   Translation Phase
       │
       ├─ [HOOK: cultural-check] (per language)
       │  └─ Check: dates, currency, formality, cultural refs
       │     └─ FAIL → Regenerate that translation
       │     └─ PASS → Continue to next language
       │
       ▼
   QA & Validation
       │
       ├─ [HOOK: quality-gate]
       │  └─ Check: all langs 85+/100
       │     └─ FAIL → Regenerate failed langs
       │     └─ PASS → Publish
       │
       ▼
   Published (13 URLs)
```

## 📊 Parallel vs Sequential Comparison

Visual comparison of execution strategies:

### Sequential (Traditional Approach) ❌

```
Timeline:
Day 1:   [ French translation: 14 min ]
Day 1:              [ German: 15 min ]
Day 1:                     [ Spanish: 13 min ]
...
Day 5:                                   [ Hindi: 19 min ]

Total: 5+ days to complete one article
```

### Parallel (Claude Code) ✅

```
Timeline:
Hour 1:  [EMEA Batch: FR, DE, ES, IT, NL ] ────► 15 min
         [APAC Batch: JA, KO, ZH-CN, ZH-TW, HI ] ► 19 min
         [AMERICAS: PT-BR, ES-MX, FR-CA ] ────► 13 min

         All execute simultaneously

Hour 1:  [QA: 12 min]
Hour 1:  [Publishing: 8 min]

Total: 19 min to complete one article × 13 languages
```

## 🎯 Success Criteria

All translations must meet these gates:

```
┌────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│         Quality Assurance Gates            │
├────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│ Completeness:   ✓ All sections translated  │
│ Formatting:     ✓ Headings/lists preserved │
│ Localization:   ✓ Dates/currency adapted  │
│ SEO metadata:   ✓ Titles/desc translated  │
│ Language:       ✓ Grammar/tone correct    │
│                                            │
│ Final Score:    ≥ 85/100 per language    │
│ Pass Rate:      ≥ 12/13 (92%)            │
│                                            │
│ Avg Time:       15–20 minutes per batch   │
│ Total Cost:     $80–150 for 13 languages │
└────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```
